scope: All saved accepted responses, five registered models, both modes, eight horizons. Incomplete models remain explicitly partial.
candidate_graph: Exactly 520 undirected event edges with observed neighbor-feature support in frozen event_edge_roles.csv; both directions considered, all historical contracts in adjacent events, no requirement of same-origin LLM predictions.
price_orientation: Frozen market_id first-outcome probabilities; no token inversion.
history_boundary: Every sampled endpoint is strictly before origin; available_at and last_trade_timestamp must be causal. Future-timestamp rows excluded only from this derived feature version.
stability: Correlation sign agrees in earlier and later chronological halves; each half has nonzero variance.
message: Past observed neighbor price changes over each forecast horizon, signed and scaled using trailing 30-day 5-minute price-change association. Normalize reliability weights; damp signals with exp(-trade_age/max(300,horizon_seconds)). No future neighbor forecasts.
lambda_selection: Fixed 0.25 declared before this experiment outcomes; no target-based tuning. Compare matched zero-neighbor shrink control.
permutation_rule: Permute accepted directed contract-origin edge signs within event-graph bundle; record unchanged signs. No future prices used.
metrics: MSE,MAE,DG,DG among truly moving targets, consistency, modification and improve/harm counts. Frozen target masks and contract-to-vid-to-original-component aggregation unchanged.
interpretation: Exploratory asynchronous historical-neighbor transfer. History alone provides association, not causation or guaranteed forecast direction. ZeroNeighbor control separates shrinkage from neighbor content. Original masks and targets unchanged.
